title: Franca lesson file
description: One lesson in a language pack. These fields tell the app what the lesson teaches, what it builds on and what it only shows, so that the warm-up and the pack builder work the same way for every language.

item_id.description: language:type:slug, for example nl:grammar:article-indefinite or zh:sound:tone-3. The type is any item type the pack defines. A variety or script subtag may follow the language, for example nl-be:lexeme:gsm or zh-hans:character:ma.

node_id.description: A lesson or unit id, for example nl:lesson:a1-u05-l03 or nl:unit:a1-u06.

teaches.description: Items that are new in this lesson.

builds_on.description: Items the lesson uses but does not teach. Core items are needed to follow the lesson; support items help. The warm-up chooses its bridge items from this list.

prompt.description: Optional recall prompt for the warm-up, such as a sentence the lesson will change. A string is the target-language answer; an object can add a transliteration and the learner's-language cue. Without it, the item's own review card is used.

cue.description: The prompt in the learner's language, by language code, for example {"en": "Do you have bread?"}

exposure_only.description: Items used in this lesson before they are taught. They are never a production target here.

preteach.description: Words taught just before the input. The maximum per level is in the course settings (4 at A1 and A2, 6 at B1).

recap_of.description: The lesson that the reminder at the start of the warm-up refers to.

returns_in.description: Lessons and units where this lesson's content comes back.

prediction.description: The guess at the start of the warm-up. It is not marked and is checked after the first listen.

answers.description: Indexes of the options that match the recording, checked after the first listen.

multiple.description: Whether the learner can choose more than one option.

feedback.description: One line per option, shown with the check after the first listen.

items.description: Every item the activity uses. The pack builder checks each one against teaches, preteach, builds_on, exposure_only and earlier lessons.

production_targets.description: Items the learner has to produce. An exposure_only item cannot be one.
